name: Robotherapy
source:
An emotional dark comedy about robots doing therapy. In Robotherapy, you're a robot therapist in a dystopian society that killed all the humans, but is still not happy. Treat patients, meet weird robots and enter their minds. If killing all humans doesn't bring happiness, then what does?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895970/Robotherapy/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部关于机器人进行治疗的情感黑色喜剧。在《机器人疗法》中，你是反乌托邦社会中的一名机器人治疗师，这个社会杀死了所有人类，但你仍然不快乐。治疗病人，遇见奇怪的机器人并进入他们的思想。如果杀死所有人类并不能带来幸福，那么什么可以呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895970/Robotherapy/]Steam[/url]]
